bgview.list.title: 🛰 Background agents
bgview.list.intro: Claude Code sessions running in the background on this machine (claude --bg, terminal sessions sent to the background). Click 👁 to watch live, like a terminal.
bgview.list.noFileTip: Session file deleted — you can still attach in the terminal
bgview.list.hubTip: Open in Hub (with a button to move the session into the Hub)
bgview.list.removeTip: Stop & remove this background agent (claude rm {id})
bgview.toast.notFound: Agent not found — try again in a few seconds
bgview.toast.noOrphans: No agents with missing session files
bgview.remove.working: {n} agent(s) still WORKING will be interrupted.
bgview.remove.message: The agent is stopped and removed from the background list (claude rm). If its worktree still has unpushed commits or changes, Claude Code refuses and reports back — no code is lost.
bgview.viewer.readOnly: view only — to send messages, open it in the Hub (⇄) or a terminal (🖥)
bgview.viewer.fileGone: This agent's session file is no longer on this machine (it may have been moved to the Trash), so its content can't be shown.
bgview.viewer.fileGoneHint: The agent is still "{state}" — click {button} to attach directly (claude attach {id}).
